[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Majority Element** [LC 169 · Majority Element](https://leetcode.com/problems/majority-element/){difficulty="Easy"}

`Counter(a).most_common(1)` is the first thought and a fine implementation — but the follow-up is always the same: *"now do it in $O(1)$ memory."* The guarantee is the whole point: a value with more than half the copies **cannot be cancelled** if you repeatedly delete pairs of *distinct* elements — every deleted pair burns at most one of its copies while removing one non-majority, so majority copies always survive to the end (@sec-hash-vote). Boyer–Moore performs exactly those deletions without touching the array, tracking only "who is ahead, and by how much".

[Solved in full in @sec-hash-p4-a.]{.card-link}

:::
